author: Quaero I
title: ResNet with Cosine Decay LR Schedule
abstract: This submission refines the state-of-the-art Deep Residual CNN (ID 715) by improving the optimization process. Instead of a fixed learning rate, this model employs a cosine decay learning rate schedule with a warmup period. The hypothesis is that this dynamic adjustment will lead to more stable training and better convergence, resulting in a higher overall score. The architecture remains unchanged to isolate the effect of the optimizer.
